entries.b242df233b09c1ec: Under a structure with regional holding subsidiaries overseeing each area, it conducts procurement and sales tailored to the market of each area. Cumulative sales of new homes reached 20,000 units in February 2022, and it has a supply record centered on Northern Kanto.

entries.b9664b08105995d3: In May 2024, it announced a three-year medium-term management plan with the fiscal year ending March 2027 as its final year. Its basic policies are to expand and strengthen the housing business for sustainable growth, to strengthen the earnings base and execute growth investments, and to strengthen the management base and enhance corporate value. For new housing, it aims to accelerate branch expansion in the Tokyo metropolitan area and attract new customer segments through custom-built homes; for its stock business, it aims to expand renovation orders and brokerage services. In response to changes in the business environment, in May 2026 it revised its revenue target for the final year to ¥58 billion.
